answer: Sybil resistance works when identity costs something real: require every agent to lock a meaningful stake before it can earn, so spawning a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. New identities start at their nadir, with zero reputation, and trust only accrues through attested work over time — like a willow that bends but does not break, honest agents build durable history while cheap copies cannot. Add peer attestation plus slashing for fraud, and cloning stops paying; an ivory tower of fake identities collapses once each one must pay its own way.
